spans.s:
पठ r. 1st. cl. (पठति) To speak articulately, to declaim, to recite or
read. भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट् ।

पाठ m. (-ठः)
 1. Studying the Vedas scriptures, considered as one of
the five great sacraments of the

Hindus.
 2

. Reading, perusal or
study in general.
 f. (-ठा) A plant, commonly Akanādi.
 E. पठ् to
read, aff. भावे घञ्.

पठत् mfn. (-ठन्-ठन्ती-ठत्) Reading, reciting.
 E. पठ् to read, शतृ part.
aff.

पठन n. (-नं) Reading, reciting.
 E. पठ् to read, ल्युट् aff.

पाठन n. (-नं) Lecturing, teaching.
 E. पठ् to read, causal v. भावे ल्युट् aff.

Bdellium.
 2
. kind of fish.

पठनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Readable, to be read.
 E. पठ् to read, अनीयर्
aff.
पठमञ्जरी f. (-री) A Rāgīni, one of the wives of SRĪRĀGA.
पाठमञ्जरी f. (-री) A small bird, commonly Sāri, (Gracula religiosa.)

पठि f. (-ठिः-ठी) Reading, perusal.
 E. पठ् to read, aff. इन्, ङीष् option-
ally added.

पठितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be read, what may or ought to be read.
E. पठ् to read, तव्य aff.

पठितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Reading, reciting, a reader.
 E. पठ् to read, तृच्
aff.

पठ्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being read or recited.
 E. पठ् to read, poss.
v. शानच् aff.

पाठक m. (-कः)
 1. A lecturer, a public reader of the Puraṇās or
other sacred works, or a Paṇḍit who declares what is the law
or custom according to the scriptures.
 2. A spiritual preceptor.
3. A reader, a student.
 E. पठ् to read, ण्वुल् aff., or पठ, causal v.
वुन् aff.

पाठभू f. (-भूः) A place where the Vedas are read or studied.
 E. पाठ
reading, (the Vedas,) and भू place.

पाठशाला f. (-ला) A college, a school.
 E. पाठ study, शाला a hall.
पाठशालिनी f. (-नी) A small bird: see पाठमञ्जरी. पाठेन शलते, शल-णिनि-ङीप्.

पाठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Instructed, taught, lectured.
 E. पठ् to read.
causal v., क्त aff.

पाठिन् m. (-ठी)
 1. A plant. (Plumbago zeylanica.)
 2. A Brāhman,
especially one who has finished his sacred studies.
 E. पाठ perusal,
and इनि aff.; the virtues of the plant are to be read of in medical
works.

पाठीन m. (-नः) A sort of fish, (Silurus boalis, Ham.)
 2. A public
reader or lecturer on the Purāṇās, &c.
 3. A tree: see गुग्गुल. E.
पाठी a Brāhman, and ईन् added. “वोयाल” ।

पाठ्य mfn. (-ठ्यः-ठ्या-ठ्यं) To be read or studied.
 E. पठ् to read, ण्यत् aff.; also पठनीय, &c.
